# OntoKin continuation handoff: C050 START (planning only)

**Prepared:** October 27, 2026 (America/Denver)  
**Project:** [Omegapy/OntoKin](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin)  
**Coordination:** [Issue #26](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/issues/26)  
**Task:** Request-local factorial-cache origin closure using existing raw tuples  
**State:** Ready for a new owner to begin *source-only feasibility work*. **No C050 branch, lease, code change, review, execution, or validation is claimed by this planning handoff.** The eventual C050 execution owner must replace this with a completed `HANDOFF-050.md` reflecting actual results.

## 1. Exact starting point and release reality

The verified preceding checkpoint is **C049**, published on branch `work/reach06-factorial-origin-feasibility-20261027-c049-e7a2`:

| Item | Verified value as checked while preparing this handoff |
| --- | --- |
| C049 final commit | `e828ee2d54b3c2a5a82bb332327fdce982a0f7f2` |
| C049 final tree | `574c75e870d50aed5e5e96b34b454389074350fe` |
| C049 parent / C048 final | `8b6df27e323797e6b93bc9b44b5cd9083d4e3859` |
| C049 review PR | [#46](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/46), open draft, not merged when checked |
| `main` when checked | `2bb4588e121fcfe99b4d42c734b15b38362f3642` |
| C049 ownership conclusion | [Issue #26 closure](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/issues/26#issuecomment-6446815924), previous owner released |
| Retained reference runtime | C035 `4ca73909f861fe4bef9694787473621c1d21c140`, held including adverse timing |
| Original28 | **24/28**, not rerun by C049; unresolved **P11, P16, P23, L03** |
| Full release / `main` integration | Neither accepted nor completed |

**These are observed predecessor facts, not authorization to assume they remain the live heads.** The incoming worker must re-observe branches, PRs, issue ownership, CI and work leases before claiming C050 ownership or writing. Do not mistake a disconnected or timed-out worker for a released lease.

The C049 source-only review completed independently scoped numerical/authority and cost reviews. It recovered 12 historical binary archives (74,915,834 bytes) to their exact published Git blobs. The unchanged documentation checker **passed** with 29 preserved sources, 233 sections, 218 documents, 1,705 local links and 93 anchors. Its recovered environment was a **partial 923-file source snapshot**, not a full checkout. No OntoKin import, candidate numerical replay, original28 run, product test, benchmark, hosted CI dispatch or merge was part of C049. New sessions must recover/check exact required inputs rather than inherit a prior validation label.

## 2. Mandatory startup for the C050 executor

1. Read live `AGENTS.md`, `GOAL.md`, `STATUS.md`, root `README.md`, `docs/README.md`, the adopted reach `ADOPTION.md`, `release-contract.md`, and **budget-counting §3**. The authoritative live files override this portable summary.
2. Read predecessor evidence, in order: [`HANDOFF-049.md`](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/e828ee2d54b3c2a5a82bb332327fdce982a0f7f2/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/HANDOFF-049.md); [`checkpoint-049-factorial-origin-feasibility.md`](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/e828ee2d54b3c2a5a82bb332327fdce982a0f7f2/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-049-factorial-origin-feasibility.md); [`checkpoint-049-cost-ledger.json`](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/e828ee2d54b3c2a5a82bb332327fdce982a0f7f2/docs/engineering/reach-recording-validation-2026-10-23/checkpoint-049-cost-ledger.json); `checkpoint-049-reviews.json`, `checkpoint-049-validation.json`, `checkpoint-049-next-scope.json`; plus C048 review/handoff and C047 lifetime review. Read actual source, not only these summaries.
3. Refresh Issue #26, [PR #46](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/pull/46), all relevant open draft PRs and branch heads, CI/Actions availability and any integration or active writing lease. Check pending/unpublished changes before edits.
4. Only after ownership is clear, create a **new owned C050 branch from the reverified final C049 publication**. Record the exact base SHA/tree and worker identity in Issue #26. Do not reuse C049's released worker, mutate its branch, or acquire a `main` integration lease merely for source design.
5. Recover enough **exact, hash-verified source and required validation dependencies** for the intended review. Distinguish a partial snapshot from a checkout, checked metadata from executed runtime tests, and restored archives from internally audited archives.

## 3. Research question (strictly bounded)

**Can a fresh native `_Arithmetic` owner with an initially empty cache establish factorial-key values as authentic outputs of `_series_factorials`, keep that authority valid or explicitly revoked across every admitted mutation and actual callback, and deliver the exact original factory-returned immutable raw tuple to `_series_coefficients`, without (a) a second persistent numerical cache slot, (b) wrappers on normal factorial hits, (c) a fresh 14-check four-helper screen per coefficient miss, or (d) uncharged per-tick overhead?**

The intended benefit is a safe admission route for the affine series-coefficient recurrence on a **new complete original request**. This is *not* a plan to retrofit C047's already resident, unreceipted factorial table or resume its failed tail. If this raw-tuple route fails a closed proof or positive **whole-request** ledger, publish the bounded NO-GO and **choose a different source-level optimization target**. Do not indefinitely iterate variants of the same unresolved receipt question.

### Source entry points to inspect

- `ontokin/reach_reference.py`: `_Arithmetic.__init__`, `_series_factorials`, `_series_coefficients`, `_series_integer`, `_series_dyadic`, `_Arithmetic.tick` and all relevant cache manipulation/call sites.
- `ontokin/reach_reference_center.py`: `_Guard.original`, `_Guard.current`, active `_recording_after_tick`, owner/precision/current-domain checks and cancellation/error propagation.
- The actual `ReachExecutionWork.charge` / `ConstructionBudget.tick` implementations and any effectful external callbacks, observers, supported map/scalar mutations, descriptors, defaults, closures and method/instance overrides.
- Adopted operation-counting contract, source independence and release/recording contracts, C047 retained source-pair observations (read only).

Do not infer that a class method appears immutable because its name resolves, or that a cache entry is genuine because it is a tuple of plausible integers. Capture every authorized native write path, plus generic/external paths that must preserve the original behavior or be excluded by provable admission.

## 4. Established mathematics and cost boundary (not candidate performance)

For genuine factorials at selected degree `D >= 1`, dyadic exponent `e >= 0`, define:

```text
F      = (2D+1)!
Q      = F * 2^(2eD)
L      = 2^bit_length(Q)
N_0    = F * (L+1)
N_i    = N_(i-1) + 2F
C_i    = (N_i / (2i+1)!) * 2^(2e(D-i))  for i < D
C_D    = L + 2D + 1
```

These are exact only in the proved genuine-factorial/native operand domain. The C048 prospective-width proof bounds the new operations by `2q+2`, `q=bit_length(Q)`, under its **fixed native limit**. It does **not** excuse cap mutations during callbacks or changed refusal positions.

| Path or proposal | Established source-derived operation accounting |
| --- | --- |
| Original coefficient full-key hit | 1 |
| Original complete coefficient miss | `4D+5` |
| Affine complete miss **before new admission costs** | `3D+6` |
| Maximum complete gross opportunity | `D-1`; **13** at `D=14` |
| Captured D14 corresponding index-7 division prefix | **4 gross** possible operations saved; failed tail not observed |
| Original factorial hit | 1 |
| Original factorial cold miss for `last >= 1` | `last+1` (subject to domain-change/callback charges) |
| Rejected fresh four-helper screen | 14 *new charged checks* (still insufficient safe admission), giving D14 complete bound `<= -1-A_complete` and prefix bound `<= -10-A_prefix` |
| Rejected existing-table recurrence migration | 28 multiplications through `29!` or 72 through `73!`, before verification; worse than 13 gross D14 room |

C049's native `bits=128` source entails `limit=36`, `last=73`. Prospective eligibility must be proved from genuinely required `last=73` factory construction in the same new complete request, through an actual later coefficient miss at `D=14`. A full-key hit still must return on the original path. The five completed new degrees 7, 8, 13, 17 and 16 offer **56 total gross** operations before all added work; no observed hit count, prospective mint event or entire-request net saving was established.

**Cost ledger rule:** Separate each path's original and new charged operations, including all extra checks, factory mint/maintenance, hits, misses, fallback, cancellation, cache eviction/clear, copies, output/publication and callbacks. Keep cold construction/startup costs in the full-request total; never double-charge them per miss or falsely omit them. Never subtract hypothetical post-index-7 work from a D14 prefix bound. Do not count an unexecuted failed tail or claim 13 is observed net saving.

## 5. Specific proof obligations, in execution order

### A. Cache-writer closure and native owner scope

Construct a source-cited table of **every writer, reader, deletion, clear, replacement, capacity eviction, alias and dynamic dispatch route** affecting factorial cache keys. Show when the fresh owner/cache is created and how the genuine factory is the only **admitted native** writer. Identify where an external/modified cache, injected tuple, replaced method, altered map type or mutated owner must cause optimization exclusion while preserving the original generic path.

### B. Provenance minting and unbroken identity

Prove genuine `0!=1`, `1!=1`, every subsequent defining multiplication and the exact tuple produced by the original guarded factory path, with publication only **after** full successful construction and all relevant callbacks. The `_series_dyadic` caller must receive the exact factory-returned tuple, not equality-compatible data or an object identified only by a recycled `id`. A cache replacement cannot inherit trust. Interrupted construction and partial publication must preserve original side effects, errors and cancellation identity; no speculative origin is minted.

### C. Callback/observer/current-limit authority

Trace the real active `_Guard.original` observer and its `_recording_after_tick` callback, `_Guard.current`, work charge/check, owner and source/native method authority, instance shadows, descriptors, globals, builtins, defaults and closures. Explicitly identify all ordinary versus possibly effectful callbacks/mapping objects. Original prospective operand limits and first refusal location must remain unchanged. **A `hooks is None` gate is disallowed:** the target actually has a non-null observer. Show where a current proof remains valid and where a callback invalidates it before further optimized operations. Avoid unchecked persistent Boolean flags or work that should have incurred tick charges.

### D. Cache lifetime, no hidden retention

Prove authenticity rules for cold entry, full-key hit, factorial hit, eligible coefficient miss, replacement, clear, eviction under **256 entries**, owner/domain change, and re-entry after interruption. Raw tuple storage should not add a second retained numerical slot or wrapper/unwrapper cost on every factorial hit. If authority cannot be proved without a retained tuple/reference, cost that strong reference as possible hidden numerical retention and capacity pressure; do not silently label it free.

### E. Complete cost / request-level feasibility

Produce an inspectable work ledger for:

- Cold owner and first factorial construction (`last=73`), publication and provenance work.
- Coefficient-key hit, factorial-key hit, genuine eligible miss, and low-degree `D=0/1/2` fallback.
- Foreign/malformed replaced entry, altered callback or limit, rejected native admission, mid-construction cancellation/failure and cache-pressure/eviction.
- Per-check, per-lookup, per-value or output occurrence work, plus error/cleanup/observer restoration and any changed temporary object widths/lifetime.
- The *entire prospective request*, from empty arithmetic state through the observed target path, including previously incurred factory maintenance and work on paths receiving no affine benefit.

A positive operation bound must still honor all original intermediate guards and result/error identities. If totals depend on unobserved events, state them symbolically and treat them as **unknown**, not free. Propose one closed finite review/hypothesis iteration, not endless speculative screening.

### F. Independent reviewers and final decision

Obtain separate source-backed reviews for (1) exact mathematics/operand limits/owner+callback authority/behavior and (2) complete charged costs/cache retention and full-request outcome. Reviewers must know which files and hashes they inspected, distinguish conditional versus proven claims and identify counterexamples. **No runtime implementation, test, candidate replay or release acceptance is authorized by this initial feasibility handoff.** A positive conclusion can only select a *subsequent*, separately reviewed bounded implementation plan under an active exclusive window.

## 6. Exit criteria and bounded alternative

**GO to a separately authorized implementation plan only if all are established:** closed writer and origin proof; exact tuple/callback/observer/limit and error identity; valid 256-entry cache lifetime with no unpriced retained values; complete all-path ledger with positive **whole-request** net saving and prospective D14 eligibility; independent numerical/authority and cost reviews; required validation dependencies available; branch/lease coordination clear.

**NO-GO and pivot:** If any of provenance, native authority, callback-stable behavior, storage, target eligibility or positive total saving cannot be proved after bounded analysis, publish the exact failed obligation and its evidence, then nominate **a different source optimization target**. Do not repeat the 14-check per-miss gate or recompute through `29!` / `73!` as though new. A **same-entry factorial receipt** is an *alternative representation hypothesis*, not the default: its wrapper/type/unwrap work on **every** hit, all original consumers and malformed-entry behavior require a separate positive ledger first.

## 7. Non-negotiable release and safety constraints

Keep the original exact factorial/polynomial values; first strict stopping degree, remainder proofs, alternating-tail and outward-grid behavior; source independence and original failure/cancellation object identity; callback timing/charge semantics; pending publication, work/error behavior and retirement. **Never** change fixtures, horizons, frames per second, helpers, tolerances, agent artifacts or expected records merely to pass a test. No failed-tail continuation, no assumed cache events, no unpriced new slots or uncharged per-tick work.

| Resource / invariant | Preserve |
| --- | ---: |
| Shared operations | **100,000** |
| Elapsed budget | **30,000 ms** |
| Max operand bits | **32,768** |
| Maximum cache entries | **256** |
| Cursor update retirement | **64 updates** |

C050 does not by itself fulfill P11/P16/P23/L03 or the release suite (R01–R12/Q01–Q22; 28 original source requests and ten retrieved Agent artifacts; independent numerical/native/browser/visual and hostile/inherited roles; CPython 3.11/3.12/3.13; formal input closure; resulting-main verification). Do not merge to `main` on the strength of this source-only checkpoint.

## 8. Required C050 publication / interruption-safe output

When the C050 worker actually performs this study, publish an **actual**, source-grounded checkpoint with:

1. `HANDOFF-050.md`: observed start/final commit/tree, named owner/branch/lease and release status, precise decision, follow-on task.
2. `checkpoint-050-factorial-cache-origin-review.md`: writer and provenance trace, native callback/observer/error proof, exact branch/counterexamples, target eligibility and explicit GO/NO-GO.
3. `checkpoint-050-cost-ledger.json`: per-path original/new charged operations, cold/factory/hit/miss/reject/retirement, full-request total/unknowns.
4. `checkpoint-050-reviews.json` and source-bound independent review records.
5. `checkpoint-050-validation.json`: exact source/archives recovered, hashes, executed commands and results, *actual* documentation gate if run, and explicit counts of runtime/numerical tests not performed.
6. `checkpoint-050-next-scope.json`: selected bounded implementation plan or concrete alternative source target with responsible owner, no speculative acceptance.
7. GitHub draft PR against correct predecessor branch (if consistent with live governance), Issue #26 publication/ownership release and immutable remote readback. Deliver an interruption-safe local/Library bundle when possible.

**If interrupted:** Summarize exact observed changes, uncommitted/unpublished files, running workers and leases, the last trusted SHA and checks, then hand off without asserting tests, commits, ownership release or a NO-GO/GO that did not occur.

## 9. Quick continuation instruction for a fresh conversation

> Continue OntoKin from this **C050 START planning handoff** and published C049 at `e828ee2d54b3c2a5a82bb332327fdce982a0f7f2`. First refresh the live repository governance, PR #46, Issue #26, actual branch heads and owners. Acquire a fresh C050 source-design lease/branch only when free. Answer the narrowly scoped request-local raw-factorial-tuple origin question with closed writer/callback/storage proofs and a full charged request ledger. Independently review. If positive, propose a separate controlled implementation plan; if not, publish the specific NO-GO and pivot to a different source optimization target. Preserve original recording behavior, all limits and no failed-tail continuation. This file is **not** evidence that C050 has begun or passed.
